aboutme.text: I'm a frontend-focused engineer with 11+ years of experience across startups, international companies, and consulting. I build React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Vue applications with a strong eye for product-focused UI, practical engineering, and full product delivery. My background also includes PHP and Node.js backend work, team leadership, mentoring, and teaching.
